    Imported and reference datasets

    METHOD

    What is measured and what is modelled

    Published location dataCommunity, small-cell and facility locations come from the listed public datasets. Location does not confirm current service.

    Facility display policyThe raw OSM file is retained, but records without a name and all generic OSM shelters are excluded from the default map and search. A generic shelter is not evidence of an emergency evacuation centre.

    Historical contextThe TC Lam track and documented community impacts provide historical context, not a current forecast.

    Scenario inputExposure, redundancy, access and the resource inventory are exercise assumptions from lam-exercise-scenario.json.

    Modelled recommendationSuggested priorities support discussion only; they are not dispatch instructions.

    Safety boundaryNetwork, road, facility and personnel conditions remain not confirmed and must be verified locally.

    Priority ranking method and weights

    The ranking compares the seven exercise communities. It is a rule-based ordering, not a prediction of impact probability.

    FactorCategory-to-point rule
    Scenario exposureHigh 30 · Medium-high 24 · Medium 18 · Low-medium 10
    Essential-service dependencyCritical 25 · High 20 · Medium 12
    Communications redundancy shortageFragile 20 · Limited 18 · Partial 10 · Higher 3
    Access difficultyHighly constrained 15 · Constrained 13 · Partly constrained 9 · Accessible with limits 4
    Historical contextDocumented impact 10 · Documented impact context 8 · Preparedness context 5 · Response context only 3 · Not verified 0
    Confidence adjustmentHigh 0 · Medium −5 · Low −10

    Category values in lam-exercise-scenario.json are converted to labelled point values. Missing values contribute no points. This score supports comparison only and does not authorise deployment.

    ABOUT

    RemoteReady NT

    RemoteReady NT combines public connectivity and facility locations with transparent priority rules to help remote communities prepare for communications disruption.

    Design references

    • First Nations Connectivity Mapping Tool — layer organisation and location search.
    • Queensland disaster dashboards — warning hierarchy, situation summaries and resource visibility.
    • Bureau of Meteorology cyclone maps — historical track communication and uncertainty.
    • Saftera — offline preparation, saved device data and mobile field tools.

    Exercise support only. Do not use this application as the sole source of emergency or navigation information.
